prompt: Refine this story: As a shopper I want to search for products so that I can find things to buy

assertions.text: Output contains the APPROVED STORY header block
Story follows correct As a / I want / so that format
assertions.check: output contains 'Story: As a' and 'I want' and 'so that'

assertions.text: Acceptance criteria are declarative statements, not Given/When/Then
assertions.check: output does NOT contain 'Given' or 'When/Then' in acceptance criteria context

assertions.text: Acceptance criteria are more specific than the original (e.g. mention search input, results, empty state, or debounce)
assertions.check: output acceptance criteria contain concrete detail beyond the original vague story

assertions.text: Output contains Story Points with justification
